note: polis interaction-rules layer (design: docs/design/food-hunger-skills-policies.md B). v2: rules are PER PLAYER — 'profiles' is keyed by player uid, 'default' is the fallback (and the only profile the pilot uses: per-settlement is a future layer beyond current scope, 2026-10-04 decision). Within a domain: highest-priority matching rule wins, no match -> domain default. Hot-reloaded on file change; 'code' supports '*' wildcards. The food domain also carries the decision parameters of the food-pressure interrupt and the forage skill (data, not code): pressure {trigger,rearm} as fractions of max saturation, forage {maxRadius,ringWidth,blocksPerTick,maxTargets,blockPatterns}, preempt {mode,waitTypes}.
